briefings.changeSummary: Confirm-the-lineup week, no changes recommended. Kicker hole from the last two briefings is closed -- Jake Bates (DET) rostered 2026-10-29 -- which lifts the total back to 138.57 from 130-133. The one FLEX call still open Wednesday (Coker vs Williams) was decided and played Thursday before this report ran: Coker started, final line 2/5/36/1 TD plus a lost fumble, 9.60 real points, recorded for the track record rather than as live advice. Drake London (fixture: Questionable, head) does not appear anywhere in Atlanta's now-complete 18-player injury report -- read as cleared; started regardless either way as the clear WR2.

Real committed fixture landed Tuesday (FantasyPros consensus + ESPN injuries), replacing Monday's sandbox-degraded bridge numbers. Headline flip: FLEX2 moves from Jalen Coker back to Jameson Williams -- Monday's sandbox had Williams ahead by a thin 0.12 points, the real fixture widens it to 1.5 points even after today's live Wednesday practice overlay raises Coker's P(play) 85.1% -> 91.7% on a Full Participation report. Drake London (Questionable, head) still has no ATL practice report filed -- his 90.4% P(play) is history-only; re-check Thursday/Friday. Kicker hole unresolved for a third straight briefing: Dominic Zvada on NYG's bye, no backup K, slot scores zero; Jake Bates (DET, 8.19 exp) is the top waiver target. Real total 132.82 vs ~140 with a kicker filled.

Pivoted to Week 8 (Week 7 closed for this roster; the one outstanding game, DAL@PHI, involves neither team). Headline problem: the only rostered kicker, Dominic Zvada, is on NYG's Week 8 bye with no bench K -- the lineup scores a placeholder zero there, which is the entire reason this week's 130.52 total reads low (fixing the kicker gap would put it at ~138.4). Claim a kicker before Wednesday -- Wil Lutz (DEN, 7.91 exp) is the top in-house option, with Jason Sanders (NYJ) and Drew Stevens (WAS) as alternatives. Secondary, thin: Jameson Williams edges bench Jalen Coker for the second FLEX spot by just 0.12, inside model noise -- recheck Wednesday. Source caveat: the committed Week 8 fixture is a stale pre-season placeholder, so this briefing is a self-generated live run with no FantasyPros tier and zero injury designations filed yet (normal five days out) -- treat as a bridge until Tuesday's CI rebuild. New byes flagged: Stafford (QB) Week 9, Irving (RB) and bench Nix (QB) Week 10.

Final designations set, clean lock: 28/32 teams filed live Week 7 reports (all 12 of this roster's teams among them), zero Out/Doubtful/Questionable tags anywhere on the roster. Two changes since Wednesday fix the whole gap: DEF Jaguars (Week 7 bye, scored zero) swapped for Jets D/ST via a 10/22 waiver move (+8.29), and Sam LaPorta's held TE edge over Isaiah Likely finally started (+0.44) -- total moves 132.79 to 141.52, exactly the sum of those two. One judgment call: bench QB Bo Nix's fixture number (19.51) beats started Matthew Stafford (18.69) only because FantasyPros' consensus hasn't caught up with Nix's real 12.1 pts/game 2026 form -- Stafford stays started, matching the owner's own same-day reversal on 10/22. Restated the Week 8 bye cluster (Zvada the only K, plus bench Shough/Skattebo/Likely) with the waiver pool still thin (one speculative K, Drew Stevens).

No lineup slot changes since Monday. Checked and held a thin TE reversal (LaPorta now edges Likely 12.28 to 11.84, inside model noise -- Likely stays). Headline, unresolved: the Vikings D/ST waiver claim Monday recommended for the Jaguars' Week 7 bye has not landed as of today's deadline -- DEF scores zero as started; real total is 132.79, not the ~144.46 it would be with Minnesota rostered. Live nflreadpy overlay: only CHI/NE have filed Week 7 reports; of this roster's 12 teams only NE has, clearing bench RB TreVeyon Henderson (Full Participation, no designation). No rostered player carries an injury designation this week.

Pivoted to Week 7 (Week 6 closed, only the irrelevant SF@WAS MNF game outstanding). Higgins in for Skattebo at FLEX (+3.33) on return from CIN's bye; LaPorta also back from DET's bye but stays benched -- Likely still outprojects him 15.44 to 12.13. Headline issue: Jaguars D/ST hits its own Week 7 bye with no bench D/ST, recommending a Minnesota waiver claim (11.67 exp @IND) before Wednesday -- without it the real total is 135.07, not 146.74. Also flagged a Week 8 NYG bye cluster (Zvada the only K, plus bench Shough/Skattebo/Likely) -- no backup kicker rostered, plan a streamer now.

No lineup slots moved from Wednesday. JSN's Thursday game is already final (25.4 actual vs 18.65 pre-game). Jalen Coker cleared -- Carolina pulled his 'Out' tag entirely (Full Participation, no designation), resolving Wednesday's flagged inconsistency; P(play) 81.5% -> 96.6%. Henderson Out -> Questionable/Limited but still trails Coker/Skattebo. Week 8's NYG bye cluster (Zvada/Skattebo/Likely + bench Shough) still unaddressed, now two weeks out.

Three bye-forced changes (LaPorta/Williams/Higgins all out via CIN/DET's Week 6 bye): Likely in at TE, Skattebo in at FLEX -- both clean -- but the second FLEX has no healthy option left, so Jalen Coker starts despite his own Out/quadriceps tag (fixture's 0.815 P(play) looks inconsistent with that tag; treated with real skepticism, not trusted at face value). TreVeyon Henderson (Out, ankle, 3.3%) stays benched. Live nflreadpy overlay confirms Jaxon Smith-Njigba's Limited Wednesday practice (89.2% P(play)); no other roster team has filed yet. Today was the waiver deadline flagged in the past two briefings for exactly this hole -- still not filled as of this run. NYG now a three-player stack (Likely/Skattebo/Zvada) vs NO.

Week 5 is effectively closed -- 14 of 15 games final, only tonight's LA@BUF remains, featuring this roster's own Stafford at QB (no BUF injury-report row for him; BUF's Ed Oliver is Out). No lineup changes since Saturday. Actual results mostly confirmed or beat the projections -- Irving's Thursday game alone went 31.5 actual on 165 rush yards and two TDs -- with Tee Higgins (4.2 actual on a cleared groin) and the Jaguars D/ST (2.0 on paper's best matchup, PHI missing Barkley/D. Smith) the two real misses. Bench Isaiah Likely doubled starter LaPorta's TE output (32.4 vs 19.8) in the same game, worth remembering as the Week 6 TE-bye answer already on the roster. Restated the severe Week 6 bye collision (Higgins, LaPorta, Jameson Williams) with the Wednesday 10/14 waiver deadline now two days out.

Three trades since Wednesday (Golden-for-LaPorta, Dicker-for-Zvada, Eagles-for-Jaguars D/ST) plus the owner's own 10/8 lineup reset (Stafford over Shough at QB, Irving to RB over Skattebo, Jameson Williams into the vacated FLEX). Refit the availability model on live Week 5 injury data (30/32 teams filed): Tee Higgins' Full Participation Friday lifts his P(play) 0.884->0.934 and expected points 13.66->14.43, the only material move. Held two separate sub-1-point FLEX/QB edges (Likely/Skattebo over Jameson Williams, Shough over Stafford) as inside model noise. Bucky Irving's Thursday game is already final (31.5 actual). Flagged a severe Week 6 bye collision: Higgins, LaPorta and Jameson Williams all out the same week, zero bench depth left over -- waiver claim needed before Wednesday.

No lineup changes since Monday. Checked and held two thin, sub-1-point edges on the fixture's own numbers (Stafford over Shough at QB +0.66, Golden over Skattebo at FLEX +0.56) -- both smaller than the model's measured error, not real signal. Live nflreadpy injury pull added nothing: only DAL/TB (tonight's Thursday game) have filed Week 5 reports, and Irving (TB) carries no designation. Tee Higgins (Questionable, groin) still has no CIN practice report -- that's the one open item for Friday.

Week 4 is effectively closed -- 15 of 16 games final, only tonight's ATL@NO remains, featuring this roster's own Shough (NO) and London (ATL) on opposite sides. No injury-report changes vs the fixture. Confirmed the owner's two moves made yesterday: Shough in for Stafford at QB (+2.95 expected points over 3 straight 22-24pt starts), and the Downs/Bowers-for-Henderson/Coker trade (Likely reclaims TE from Bowers). Flagged a Week 6 WR crunch: Higgins and Jameson Williams bye the same week, needs a waiver add before then; Coker (newly traded for) byes Week 5 and is still Questionable on a quad.

No lineup changes since Wednesday -- confirmed against a now-complete live injury report (all 32 teams filed, up from CLE/PIT only). Zero Out/Doubtful/Questionable tags landed on this roster; Bowers' Weeks 1-3 Out/Doubtful/Questionable trend did not repeat, de-risking the TE call. Dart still sits in the nominal QB slot, not moved to IR, five briefings running.

Fresh committed fixture landed (regenerated Monday afternoon with FantasyPros consensus + ESPN injuries, replacing Monday's sandbox-degraded numbers): start Skattebo (13.64) over Likely (10.31), +3.33 net -- Bowers now fills TE outright at 12.16 despite the lowest play probability in the lineup (0.801, entirely a Weeks 1-3 history effect, no fresh Week 4 signal). No rostered player's team has filed a Week 4 practice report yet (only CLE/PIT have); Dart still sits in the nominal QB slot, not moved to IR.

Pivoting to Week 4 (the committed Week 4 fixture predates the season and is unusable; regenerated live via generate_report.py, no vendor sources reachable in this sandbox). Dart remains out for the season and unrostered from the lineup, still not moved to IR. Bowers starts for the first time this year, over Higgins, on a ~1.4-point expected-value edge despite an Out/Doubtful/Questionable history in Weeks 1-3 and no Week 4 report yet -- Higgins is the safer alternative. New: Higgins and Jameson Williams share a Week 6 bye, flagged for waiver planning.

No changes since Wednesday -- confirmed against a now-full live injury report (30/32 teams with a final designation, up from 22 rows). Golden's Thursday game is already final (5/12 for 100 yards and a TD); Dart still needs to move to IR.

Fifth version, after the blend, injury-source and depth-chart fixes: Stafford for Dart (season-ending knee surgery; move him to IR and claim a backup QB); Higgins for Williams; everything else holds from Monday, Golden at FLEX by 0.36 over Downs; Likely over a Questionable Bowers pending Friday.
